description: Roadmap steps whose 'Done when' needs real hardware, real software, real accounts or real (consented) media, which no CI runner has. Read from each repository's roadmap on main on 2026-11-20. scripts/field_test.py records a result against one of these ids. A measurement key is <condition>.<metric>; a condition may carry a detail after a colon (lecture-hall:dereverb).

steps.title: Measured on Japanese conference recordings
steps.done_when: a report with DER per condition from a machine with the weights
needs: a machine with the pyannote weights installed (DIARIZATION_PIPELINE_DIR; `diarization-skill doctor` reports the engine)
a reference turn file per recording, labelled by a person
steps.media: consented recordings: a panel, a Q&A with floor microphones, a two-person interview; each with and without overlapping speech

metrics.speakers: number of speakers in the reference

steps.how: DIARIZATION_DER_MEDIA=<file> DIARIZATION_DER_REFERENCE=<rttm> diarization-skill score (or the env-gated tests); one run per condition
steps.report_goes_to: diarization-skill: docs/ (a report committed as the step says), with this result file linked

steps.title: Measured on real Japanese venue recordings
steps.done_when: a report committed for each op on at least 10 minutes per condition, with the WER change
needs: the voice-enhance engines installed (Linux engine job set-up)
transcription-skill for WER, and a human reference transcript per clip
steps.media: consented recordings, at least 10 minutes per condition: a lecture hall with reverberation, a lapel mic, a handheld mic with PA bleed, a panel with three mics
steps.how: per condition and op (isolate, dereverb, bleed-reduce): run the op, measure before and after; write the op after the condition, e.g. lecture-hall:dereverb.wer_after_pct
steps.report_goes_to: voice-enhance-skill: one report per op; EXPERIMENTAL is lifted per op only with it

steps.title: Real-NLE check
steps.done_when: a fixture per NLE in `tests/fixtures/` exported by the real NLE, read back by `diff`
steps.media: the exports nle-bridge-skill writes (OTIO, FCP7 XML, EDL + SRT) for a short fictional edit; no recording of people needed

metrics.imports: the file imports without error (yes / no)
metrics.diff_clean: nle-bridge diff on the NLE's own export finds no change (yes / no)

steps.how: import each export, look, then export from the NLE and run `nle-bridge diff` against the plan; record the NLE version with --env
steps.report_goes_to: nle-bridge-skill: the NLE's export as tests/fixtures/<nle>/..., with this result file

steps.title: First real uploads on test accounts
steps.done_when: a recorded private upload per platform, with its processing status
needs: a test account per platform, with the credentials publish-skill reads (never written into a result)
steps.media: a short fictional test clip with its thumbnail and captions

metrics.privacy: the privacy the platform shows (must be private or unlisted)

steps.how: `publish upload` dry run, then `--confirm` with the token, private visibility; read the processed facts back from the platform
steps.report_goes_to: publish-skill: docs/, with this result file; delete the test uploads afterwards

steps.title: Tempo-targeted generation on the real engine (and a real loop bed, step 7)
steps.done_when: ffmpeg-skill `scenes --beats` on the output agrees with the written grid within 20 ms
needs: a GPU with ACE-Step 1.5 installed (under 4 GB VRAM for the default model)
qc-skill with the loop seam check (1.3.0 or later)
steps.media: generated by the engine; no recording needed

metrics.max_beat_error_ms: largest gap between the written grid and the measured beats, ms
metrics.loop_seam_pass: qc-skill loop seam check over 10 repeats (yes / no)

steps.how: `generate-bgm --bpm N --seconds 15`, then ffmpeg-skill `scenes --beats` on the audio and compare with <name>.beats.json; for loop-bed, repeat 10 times and run qc-skill
steps.report_goes_to: sound-design-skill: docs/ (measurement), with this result file

steps.title: Optional second engine: the GPU run of haas_ja
steps.done_when: the step is ticked on selector tests; its note says 'GPU run still to do': a real run on Linux with an NVIDIA GPU
needs: Linux with an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA
steps.media: the repository's Japanese fixture, or a consented Japanese recording

metrics.cer_pct: character error rate against the fixture's text, %

steps.how: transcribe with `engine: haas_ja`; compare with the reference text
steps.report_goes_to: transcription-skill: the step's note, with this result file

steps.title: Word-alignment engine: the real whisperX run
steps.done_when: the step is ticked on fake-module tests; its note says 'a real run still to do'
needs: whisperX and its wav2vec2 alignment weights installed (a GPU helps; CPU works slowly)
steps.media: an English clip with a known script (fictional or consented), and the Japanese fixture
steps.how: transcribe with `engine: whisperx`; check the word times against the audio
steps.report_goes_to: transcription-skill: the step's note, with this result file

steps.title: Japanese dictionary words on real recognition output
steps.done_when: the step is ticked on unit tests; its note says 'a run on real Japanese recognition output still to do'
needs: a real recognition engine (faster-whisper or another)
steps.media: a consented Japanese recording of at least a few minutes

metrics.qc_reads_it: qc-skill's subtitle-vs-speech check reads the transcript (yes / no)

steps.how: transcribe with `word_segmentation: "dictionary"`, then hand the transcript to qc-skill
steps.report_goes_to: transcription-skill: the step's note, with this result file

steps.title: Discs on set-top players
steps.done_when: people with a set-top player can report what works: menus, remote keys, audio / subtitle switching and end actions
needs: a set-top DVD or Blu-ray player (record its make, model and firmware with --env)
a disc burner and blank media, or a disc oncemore built
steps.media: a disc built by oncemore from fictional material

metrics.remote_keys: title, menu, chapter keys behave (yes / no)
metrics.end_action: the disc does what it should at the end (yes / no)

steps.how: until oncemore's one-command test disc exists, use any disc it built with menus, two audio tracks and subtitles; repeat per player
steps.report_goes_to: oncemore: an issue or docs/, with this result file
